title_zh: PLanAR：面向机器人操作的规划语言接地智能体推理
one_line: A VLM grounds a PDDL domain; an action checker verifies preconditions and effects after each skill and triggers replanning, tested on real UR5e/Franka trials.
one_line_zh: VLM 在 PDDL 规划语言中推理，逐步检查动作前置条件与效果并在偏差时重规划，在 UR5e 与 Franka 真机上验证。

online_eval.quote: We first evaluate eight single-VLM pipelines on the sorting task, using 20 real-robot trials across six object setups spanning fruits, blocks, toys, and tools.

variance.quote: using 20 real-robot trials across six object setups spanning fruits, blocks, toys, and tools

strong_baselines.quote: All configurations use the same VLM backend, perception stack, robot platform, and skill library: VLM-Direct , which directly predicts an action sequence; VLM+PDDL (Open-Loop) , which executes a symbolic plan without verification

budget_matched.quote: This robustness, however, comes at the cost of longer runtime, since PLanAR invokes additional verification and replanning steps after detected failures.

cost_reported.quote: Gemini Flash is the most reliable single-backend pipeline, combining low latency with stable visual grounding.

component_ablation.quote: We ablate the roles of planning-language grounding and execution-time verification on our Franka Panda adaptation of PLanAR.

validator_check.quote: we further evaluate five modules in the PLanAR pipeline: task parser, object detector, action checker, grasp planner, and goal checker

evidence_level.quote: We also transfer PLanAR to a Franka Panda arm using the same symbolic domain, action schemas, and verification prompts, changing only the low-level execution wrapper.

S1.quote: In contrast, PLanAR detects that the expected grasp effect failed, updates the symbolic state, replans, and completes the task.

F1.quote: Models such as Qwen-VL-Max and GPT-5.2 achieve near-zero success primarily due to unreliable execution-state verification.

F2.quote: A common failure mode is hallucination during action checking. For example, the model may claim the object is not in the gripper after a successful pick.

AP3.quote: using 20 real-robot trials across six object setups spanning fruits, blocks, toys, and tools
